Luxury Furnished Residences in Washington DC
A Sophisticated Setting for Extended Stays
AKA White House provides sophisticated accommodations perfect for extended stays in Washington, D.C. Whether you need a convenient base between meetings and appointments, a temporary home away from home while renovating, or a relaxing retreat as you explore area attractions, AKA’s designer spaces and thoughtful comforts will anticipate your every need. With everything from sleek bathrooms and fully equipped kitchens to spacious terraces and panoramic views, the one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and penthouse suites provide a refined alternative to hotels and apartment rentals and ensure an inspiring stay.
AKA White House puts you just two blocks from the nation’s most important residential address and close to many of the capital’s noteworthy commercial, governmental, and cultural institutions, including the World Bank, the Treasury Department, and the International Monetary Fund. In your downtime, take a picturesque stroll through Farragut Square or leafy Lafayette Square, before heading south to visit the iconic National Mall, home of the Washington Monument and Lincoln Memorial. When the sun goes down, sample the lively dining and nightlife of nearby Dupont Circle — known to be some of the city’s best.

AMENITIES
Whether you’re relaxing in the inviting lounge, working out in the 24-hour fitness center with state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, making use of the professional boardroom, or sipping a drink at the end of the day on our rooftop terrace, the amenities at AKA White House will inspire every aspect of your stay.

SERVICES
From complimentary Wi-Fi and same-day valet laundry service to meticulous housekeeping, business facilities, and more, AKA White House offers a range of thoughtful services to elevate your experience. Our Resident Services Team is on hand to take care of dinner reservations, event tickets, and anything else you might need.

One-Bedroom Suites in Washington DC
Enjoy All the Comforts of Home
The exquisitely appointed one-bedroom suites at AKA White House are perfect for extended stays in Washington, D.C. These sophisticated residences have plenty of room for relaxing, working, or hosting, making them a great alternative for luxury hotels and monthly apartment rentals. Whether you’re visiting with family, in town for meetings or appointments, or seeking a temporary home away from home during renovations, these spaces are sure to inspire your stay.
One-bedroom suites here range from 700 to 800 square feet and balance high-end amenities and services with a range of thoughtful home comforts. Fast, reliable Wi-Fi keeps you connected, while the two flat-screen TVs with HBO and premium channels keep you entertained. When you’re ready to unwind, retire to the plush king bed and sleek, spa-like bathrooms. Two-Bedroom Suites in Washington DC
Extra Space and Comfort for a Serene Stay
Whether you’re hosting colleagues, relaxing with family, getting some work done, or anything in between, AKA’s two-bedroom suites are spacious, serene sanctuaries that adapt to your lifestyle. These sophisticated residences combine the services of a luxury hotel with the privacy of a monthly apartment rental, creating your own high-end home away from home in Washington DC perfect for extended stays.
Two-bedroom suites here range from 1,000 to 1,100 square feet, with one king bedroom, one queen bedroom, and two sleek bathrooms. Design Details
The Innovators and Inspiration Behind Our Design
Inspired by a residential living room, a.lounge at AKA White House was designed by Meyer Davis Studio, a globally recognized New York City-based design boutique specializing in residential, hospitality, retail, and workplace environments. Founded by Will Meyer and Gray Davis, the firm has established itself at the forefront of high-end commercial and residential design practices throughout the U.S. and abroad.
Nicholas Cardone was the creative mind behind our elegant penthouse collection, which features custom-designed contemporary furnishings and upholstery, spacious living areas, and fully equipped gourmet kitchens with quartz countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and full range of chef’s accessories. A sophisticated gray color palette is enhanced by hand-selected lighting imported from Italy.

Explore the White House Neighborhood
Home to Iconic Cultural Attractions
Located just two blocks from the country’s most notable residential address, AKA White House puts you close to many of the capital’s noteworthy commercial, governmental, and cultural institutions. Whether you’re looking forward to leisurely strolls through Farragut Square and leafy Lafayette Square, visiting the iconic Washington Monument and Lincoln Memorial, or sampling the lively dining and nightlife of nearby Dupont Circle, this is right where you want to be.
Where to Eat in Washington, D.C.: There’s no shortage of exquisite restaurants to dine at in Washington, D.C., and AKA White House is situated near some of the best. Just a 10-minute walk from AKA White House, and located with our sister property Hotel AKA Washington Circle, a.kitchen+bar offers seasonal small plates brought to you by the award-winning team behind High Street Hospitality Group and Ellen Yin, James Beard Foundation 2023 Outstanding Restaurateur. Pay homage to French café culture at Le Diplomate, with classic French dishes, a thoughtfully curated wine list, and a tempting cocktail program. For New American cuisine, try Rose’s Luxury, a historic townhouse converted into a cozy restaurant. When you’re ready for a taste of D.C. history, head to Martin’s Tavern — said to have once hosted JFK and Jackie O., this eatery is known for its American classics, dark wooden bar, and stained-glass light fixtures. We also recommend the modern brasserie vibe of The Smith and the market-driven menu at Founding Farmers DC.
Official dining list: a.kitchen+bar, 1010 New Hampshire Ave. NW; Le Diplomate, 1601 14th St. NW; Fiola Mare, 3050 K Street NW Suite 101; Taberna del Alabardero, 1776 I Street NW; Founding Farmers - D.C., 1924 Pennsylvania Avenue NW; Old Ebbitt Grill, 675 15th St NW; 1789, 1226 36th St NW; Joe's Seafood Prime Steak & Stone Crab, 750 15th St NW.
Shopping in Washington, D.C.: AKA White House is conveniently located near some of the best shopping in Washington, D.C., from grand shopping centers to exclusive boutiques. We recommend heading over to Georgetown’s picturesque M Street, where you’ll find brands such as AllSaints, Club Monaco, BOSS, alo, Design Within Reach, and Lululemon — to name a few. Alternatively, you can head east past the White House to Penn Quarter and Chinatown, which together make up one of the city’s bustling commercial hubs.
Official shopping list: CityCenterDC, 825 10th St NW; Hermes, 944 Palmer Alley NW; Eastern Market, 225 7th St SE; Fashion Center at Pentagon City, 1100 S Hayes St, Arlington VA.
Washington, D.C. Museums and Art Galleries: Washington D.C.’s museums and art galleries are some of the most celebrated in the country — if not the world. Across the street from AKA White House, the Renwick Gallery of the Smithsonian American Art Museum was the first building in the United States built specifically to be an art museum. The beautiful 1858 structure, just steps from the White House, is a National historic landmark that exhibits American contemporary craft. Lining the nearby National Mall are the city’s most famous museums, from the National Gallery of Art to the Hirshhorn Museum, renowned for its works of modern and contemporary art.
Official museum list: Renwick Gallery, 1661 Pennsylvania Ave. NW; National Gallery of Art, Constitution Ave. NW; Hirschorn Museum, Independence Ave. SW. & 7th St. SW; National Museum of African American History and Culture, 1400 Constitution Ave; National Museum of the American Indian, Fourth St + Independence Ave.
Outdoor Activities in Washington, D.C.: A famously beautiful city, Washington, D.C.’s outdoor spaces are equally inspiring and relaxing. Take a walk down the National Mall from the United States Capitol Building to the Washington Monument to the Lincoln Memorial. Spend some time in the revitalized Wharf district, where new parks, restaurants, and bars have popped up along the Washington Channel. We also recommend exploring the Georgetown Waterfront Park, located near shopping and dining in Georgetown, where outdoor adventures on the Potomac River can easily be arranged.
Official outdoors list: National Mall, 2 15th St NW; Georgetown Waterfront Park, 3303 Water St NW; The Wharf, 760 Maine Ave SW.

name: The Lansburgh
tagline: Offering short-term furnished apartments and unfurnished luxury apartments, The Lansburgh is located in Washington DC’s Penn Quarter.
description:
WELCOME TO The Lansburgh
Offering short-term furnished apartments and unfurnished luxury apartments, The Lansburgh is located in Washington DC’s Penn Quarter. We are the perfect location for those who prefer city living in a desirable area within steps to entertainment, restaurants, and DC’s historic monuments.
The Lansburgh offers flexible lease terms. Our serviced apartments are ideal for those in Washington DC on temporary assignment, corporate travel or extended stay vacation. Once you reside with us you will see why The Lansburgh is a great place to call home.
Unique Floorplans. Blocks from the Capitol. Metro stops near by. Restaurants in walking distance.
Offering furnished and unfurnished residences, when you reside with us you will see why we feel the Lansburgh is a great place to call home.
We are located just north of Pennsylvania Ave., midway between The White House and The United States Capitol.

Furnished Corporate Apartments
The Lansburgh specializes in Extended Stay Rentals, Short term Apartment Rentals, Relocation Rentals, and Business Travel of thirty days or longer. Located within steps to FBI, DHS, and other government agencies. We offer comfortable serviced apartments for those on TDY Government assignment and business travelers.
What are they?
The Lansburgh specializes in Extended Stay Rentals, Short term Apartment Rentals, Relocation Rentals, and Business Travel. Located within steps to FBI, DHS, and other government agencies. We offer comfortable serviced apartments for those on TDY Government assignment, vacation travel and business travelers. With over 100 furnished apartments we can accommodate larger groups preferring to have their associates at the same location. This is a great option for theater groups, government agencies or corporations bringing several associates to the area at once. Your coworkers will be able to spend their time in Washington, DC working and enjoying all the events and sites that the city has to offer.
Offering flexible lease terms, our serviced apartments are ideal for those in Washington DC on temporary assignment or corporate travel. Each apartment is professionally cleaned and inspected before move in. Once you reside with us you will see why The Lansburgh is a great place to call home. Our apartments each have a washer and dryer, full size kitchen and living area. The 24 hour front desk can accept food deliveries and packages. Much more spacious than the average hotel room, you will truly feel like you’re in a place you belong.

Furnished FAQs
What is a Corporate/Furnished Apartment?
A corporate/furnished apartment is an apartment which includes furniture, appliances, dishes, cutlery, cookware, house-wares, linens, towels, cable television, telephone service, Internet access and utilities. While similar to a hotel room, corporate/furnished apartments are generally larger and feature the conveniences of an apartment such as full kitchens and separate bedrooms.
Will the leasing office run a credit check if I rent a corporate/furnished apartment?
Yes. A credit check will be performed on individual applicants or on a business if a corporate entity applies in place of an individual.
Do I have to sign a lease for corporate/furnished housing?
Yes. Individuals and business applicants will be asked to execute a Lease Agreement for all apartment rentals.
Do I have to pay tax on corporate/furnished housing?
It depends on tax status, length of stay and type of travel. Unless you are tax exempt or traveling on a Federal Government TDY, A tax of 14.5% applies in the District of Columbia on all Leases for periods shorter than 91 days.
Must I provide a notice to vacate before the end of my lease?
Yes. Notice to vacate is required in writing 30 days prior to moving out of the apartment.
Does The Lansburgh rent corporate/furnished apartments for less than 30-days?
Our general policy on furnished rentals is that a minimum stay of 30 days is required for standard rates. There are a limited number of Guest Suites in which we will accommodate shorter stays. Rates for shorter stays are higher than standard rates and are based on the length of stay.
Is parking included with the Lease?
No. Parking is available in our garage for an additional fee. It is available on a daily and monthly basis from Colonial Parking or from the Management Office. There is an administrative fee charged if parking is arranged through the Management office.

Luxurious resort-style living for the Government and Corporate Traveler! Our goal is to pamper you so that you’ll awake each day, excited to be working in the most exciting city in the world.

Incentive Programs
Federal Government Employee, United States Armed Forces & Department of Defense Discount Programs to Associate Incentive Programs.
The Lansburgh staff takes great pride in the dedication and commitment of those who serve and defend our nation and in the accomplishments of academic scholarship. In recognition of government service and academic achievement, The Lansburgh is pleased to offer incentive programs for employees of the United States Federal Government, those who serve in the United States Armed Forces, Recent Graduates and First Year Associates.
The Lansburgh’s fully furnished Corporate and Executive Suites offers Government Travelers an alternative to a traditional hotel stay and staff with expertise in the unique requirements of U.S. Government Travelers. Our Leasing Staff has over a decade of experience in housing U.S. Military personnel, Federal Civilian Employees and Cost-Reimbursable Federal Contractors.
The Lansburgh offers Corporate Rental Rates that fall within annual TDY and Domestic and International Per Diem Scheduled Rates.
Conveniently located downtown at 425 8th Street NW, The Lansburgh is within blocks of FBI Headquarters, The United States Capitol, The White House, over a dozen Federal Government Department Headquarters and Federal Agencies, and four Metrorail Stations.
On Furnished Apartments: We will offer extremely flexible lease terms to members of the United States Armed Forces and Federal Government Employees. A Military-Out clause is included in each Lease Agreement.
Included within your daily/month rate are the following: Elegant Lobbies with 24-hour attended front desk; Full service 24-hour health club with sky lit indoor multi-lap swimming pool, steam room, sauna, and Jacuzzi. Separate aerobics room, exercise room and men’s and ladies’ locker rooms; Electronic card access system; Full concierge services; Full size washing machine and clothes dryer in each apartment; Fully equipped kitchens; Business center with 24-hour resident access; Free high speed internet access.
On Unfurnished Apartments (not used as SA rates): We will waive your application fee ($75.00); We will waive your move-in fee ($500.00) on all unfurnished apts.; We will offer lease terms ranging from 6 months to 18 months; A Military-Out clause is included in each Lease Agreement.

Luxury Apartment Rentals (unfurnished luxury lease product; same building amenities)
Please call us at 202-393-1800 to ask about our unfurnished apartment specials.
The Lansburgh is where you want to live in Penn Quarter!
Innovative designs, spacious floor plans and elegant appointments are the hallmark of our distinguished apartments, creating the perfect city oasis of comfort and luxury. With high ceilings, vast windows of every shape and size, dramatic loft and duplex designs, the style of The Lansburgh is unparalleled.
Additional luxury-page amenities: Entertainment/conference room; Area shops and restaurants including Jaleo, MatchBox, District Chophouse and Hill Country.

Loft-Style Apartments
The Lansburgh offers a wide selection of floor plans including Loft-Style Apartments. At the Lansburgh, we take pride in the fact that all of our apartments are unique. Our Loft-Style apartments feature an upstairs/overhead loft area that is partially open to, and overlooks, the main living space. Usually this mezzanine is a bedroom, although in certain circumstance it could be a home office space, a sitting room, etc. Perfect for those who enjoy the open feel that it provides.

Floor Plans
The Lansburgh offers a wide selection of floor plans. Whether your looking for a one or two bedrooms apartments, great views, 10 foot ceilings or loft style apartments, we have everything you could want in an apartment home. At the Lansburgh, we take pride in the fact that all of our apartments have a unique floor plan.

Our Neighborhood
The Lansburgh was one of the first residential properties to be developed in the Penn Quarter / Chinatown / Gallery Place neighborhood and is located just north of Pennsylvania Avenue, midway between The White House and The United States Capitol. Penn Quarter’s initial growth occurred under the auspicies of the Pennsylvania Avenue Development Corporation whose Pennsylvania Avenue Plan called for a mixed-use neighborhood that included residences, offices, theatres and other cultural venues, retail and restaurants in both new and renovated buildings framing new parks and plazas. The nearby Verizon Center, which opened in 1997, stimulated the revitalization of adjacent blocks to the north and east and expanded the Penn Quarter neighborhood so that it now surrounds Chinatown.

Getting Around DC
Located just north of Pennsylvania Avenue, midway between The White House and The United States Capitol. The Metro is a convenient and stress-free way to get around the Washington, DC metropolitan area. From the Lansburgh you can explore D.C. and its Virginia and Maryland suburbs without the hassles of traffic and parking or the expense of gas. Penn Quarter and many other surrounding neighborhoods and sites are easily accessed by foot as well. The Verizon Center, the Spy Museum and Chinatown are within just a few blocks. The White House and most of the National Mall are within a ten minute walk.
Penn Quarter is served by the following Metro Stations: Archives – Navy Memorial – Penn Quarter; Gallery Place – Chinatown; Metro Center; Silver Line.

Our Response to COVID-19 (still published)
The Lansburgh continues to take pride in cleanliness: During this time we would like to highlight the commitment that we have to providing a clean, comfortable, and sanitary place for you to call home.
Standard Services that we continue to offer: Professionally cleaned and sanitized apartments with every move out; The use of cleaning products that are CDC approved; 24 hour front desk where you can receive contactless deliveries with no touch pick up; Virtual tours for new prospects and residents; Professional cleaners on site daily to wipe down and clean common areas; Fully furnished apartments for extended stays that have full size kitchens and areas that you can make your own while away from home; Contactless payment and leasing options available.
Cancellation Policy — Furnished Apartments: The Lansburgh understands and has always understood that plans may change. Now more than ever is our cancellation policy relevant. If your plans have changed, you can cancel any time before move in. If your stay is cut short, we will adjust the billing to reflect the needed changes.
